arb.text: The Narrator is a creative designer working late who finds the Homelost Elf card too simple and lacking character, until the power goes out and he is suddenly transported into a dim cave in Jund.

There a young girl named Eleni of the Knotvine tribe takes him for a wizard and asks him to save them, but his powers do not work without mana, and when an undead wurm plunges through the ceiling, it separates the two.

Trapped on a ledge as the wurm charges, the Narrator tells Eleni to use the relic of Progenitus, and she shouts a command word that disintegrates the wurm, after which she rescues him and becomes one of a human warrior-clan.
He wakes in his bedroom to find the card's art changed to a capable warrior, and he renames it.
